rule: Umbrella criterion 4's second half, mechanised by scripts/sole_home_scan.py. Every row excuses one (source, value) pair: a 'coincidence' says the integer is not that shape count at all, a 'forced_restatement' says it is and that R-17, R-19 or R-34 made writing it unavoidable. The forced rows are criterion 4's OPEN RESIDUE -- gap G5 of docs/receipts/campaign-close-report.md -- not its discharge. They are counted here so the residue cannot grow in silence, which is the whole difference between a gap and a habit.
how_a_row_retires: A forced row retires when the umbrella rules how a leaf's own adjudicating receipt states that leaf's value -- an amendment carving out the fingerprint counters from criterion 4, or a snapshot shape that keeps them out of the compared leaves. Editing the nine sources is not available: a superseded oracle receipt is never edited (R-15/R-18 amendment) and a commit body is history.
